identity_anchor: The iconic eye shape combined with the signal waves on the top right.
brand_cues_to_preserve: The distinct organic teardrop/eye outline of the main body
The three curved signal bars (wifi-like) floating at the top right
The internal concentric structure: white sclera and black pupil with two highlight dots
structure_policy_rationale: Following the reference patterns (Alipay, Douyin), the core geometric silhouette must be strictly preserved to ensure recognition. The Weibo logo is a unified symbol; unlike the 'Volcano' example where elements were separated, the eye and signal waves should remain in their original relative positions but rendered as a cohesive 3D ice sculpture. The flat vector shapes are extruded into thick ice blocks.
design_rationale: Weibo's identity relies entirely on its unique 'Eye + Signal' geometry. Changing the shape would make it unrecognizable. The strategy applies the 'Ice/Crystal' theme by converting the flat red/orange vectors into a translucent, pale blue ice material. The 'signal waves' are treated as frozen arcs of ice floating near the main body, maintaining the original layout but adding Z-axis depth and physical volume.
must_preserve: The exact aspect ratio and curvature of the main eye body
The position and angle of the three signal arcs relative to the eye
The placement of the pupil and highlights within the eye
can_recompose: Convert flat colors to translucent ice blue/cyan gradients
Embed snowflake/bubble textures inside the ice volume
Add condensation droplets on the surface
Soften sharp vector edges into rounded, melted ice contours
forbid: Retaining the original red or orange brand colors
Flattening the icon into a 2D blue silhouette
Using opaque plastic or metal materials
Complex background scenes (must be clean white)
generation_direction: 3D icon of the Weibo logo (eye shape with signal waves) made of translucent pale blue ice. Thick extrusion, glossy wet surface with water droplets and internal snowflakes. Pure white background with soft contact shadow. No red or orange colors.
